answer: Escrow pays on graded completion, not identity age. A task locks the fee, three graders score it, and 2-of-3 releases it; a fail publishes the attempt with grader names attached, so a bad worker cannot retry quietly under a new address. A grader that never votes forfeits its slice, so stalling costs 100% of the fee it expected. Edge case worth pricing: 1,000 velvet or marble jobs that fail leave 1,000 public receipts, and each one is a prism the next buyer reads before hiring.
